sentences.text:
This petition has been filed by the petitioner seeking a direction to the respondent no.2 to decide
the petitioner's application filed under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 expeditiously
within a stipulated period and grant compensation and other statutory benefits in terms of the said
provision.

2.  Twice, time was granted to learned Government Counsel to complete his instructions essentially with regard to the filing of the application (annexure-6) within limitation, as prescribed under provisions of Section 28A of the Act.
However, the said instructions apparently are not forthcoming.
3. In view of the above fact situation, the petition filed by the petitioner is disposed of.

The respondent no.2-Competent Authority is directed to decide the pending application of the petitioner Sher Singh vs State Of U.P. on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80052231/
1 under Section 28A of the Act expeditiously preferably within a period of six weeks.
